title: This is an autopkgtest update to check for the realmd bug[1].
description:
This is an autopkgtest update to check for the realmd bug[1].

Right now this won't pass in tenacious for two reasons:
- there are no lxd images for tenacious yet, so the whole samba-ad-dc-provisioning-internal-dns test will fail, regardless of this change
- the realmd update is in another MP, to be filed

For stonking and older the tests can be run.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~ahasenack/+archive/ubuntu/realmd-renew/+packages


1. https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/realmd/+bug/2172750

+machine_account_password_renewal_test_realmd_sssd() {
+    local server="${1}"
+    local computer_name="${server}"
+    local domain_section="domain/${realm,,}"
+    local initial_when_changed
+    local current_when_changed
+    local -i timeout=70
+    local -i interval=5
+    local -i elapsed=0
+
+    echo "## Stopping sssd in member server"
+    lxc exec "${server}" -- systemctl stop sssd
+
+    tweak_sssd_machine_password_renewal "${server}" "${domain_section}"
+
+    force_machine_account_password_expiry "${computer_name}"
+
+    echo "## Sampling whenChanged for ${computer_name}"
+    initial_when_changed=$(samba-tool computer show "${computer_name}" | grep -E "^whenChanged")
+    echo "## Initial whenChanged: ${initial_when_changed}"
+    if [ -z "${initial_when_changed}" ]; then
+        echo "## FAIL: could not read whenChanged for ${computer_name}"
+        return 1
+    fi
+
+    echo "## Starting sssd in member server"
+    lxc exec "${server}" -- systemctl start sssd
+
+    echo "## Polling whenChanged for machine password renewal"
+    while [ ${elapsed} -lt ${timeout} ]; do
+        sleep ${interval}s
+        elapsed=$((elapsed+interval))
+        echo "## Polling whenChanged (${elapsed}/${timeout}s)"
+        current_when_changed=$(samba-tool computer show "${computer_name}" | grep -E "^whenChanged")
+        if [ -n "${current_when_changed}" ] && [ "${current_when_changed}" != "${initial_when_changed}" ]; then
+            echo "## whenChanged updated: ${current_when_changed}"
+            return 0
+        fi
+    done
+
+    echo "## FAIL: whenChanged did not update after ${timeout}s"
+    return 1
+}
+
+tweak_sssd_machine_password_renewal() {
+    local server="${1}"
+    local domain_section="${2}"
+
+    echo "## Setting ad_machine_account_password_renewal_opts for renewal task every 60s"
+    lxc exec "${server}" -- /bin/sh -c "\
+        if grep -q '^ad_machine_account_password_renewal_opts' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf; then \
+            sed -r -i 's/^ad_machine_account_password_renewal_opts.*/ad_machine_account_password_renewal_opts = 60:5/' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf; \
+        else \
+            sed -i '\\|^\\[${domain_section}\\]|a ad_machine_account_password_renewal_opts = 60:5' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf; \
+        fi; \
+        if grep -q '^ad_maximum_machine_account_password_age' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf; then \
+            sed -r -i 's/^ad_maximum_machine_account_password_age.*/ad_maximum_machine_account_password_age = 1/' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf; \
+        else \
+            sed -i '\\|^\\[${domain_section}\\]|a ad_maximum_machine_account_password_age = 1' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf; \
+        fi; \
+        chmod 600 /etc/sssd/sssd.conf"
+}
+
+force_machine_account_password_expiry() {
+    local computer_name="${1}"
+    local computer_dn
+
+    echo "## Forcing machine account password to look expired"
+    computer_dn=$(samba-tool computer show "${computer_name}" | awk -F': ' '/^dn:/{print $2}')
+    if [ -z "${computer_dn}" ]; then
+        echo "## FAIL: could not read DN for ${computer_name}"
+        return 1
+    fi
+    cat <<EOF | ldbmodify -H ldap://localhost -U "Administrator%${adminpass}"
+dn: ${computer_dn}
+changetype: modify
+replace: pwdLastSet
+pwdLastSet: 0
+EOF
+}
+
+machine_account_password_renewal_test_realmd_winbind() {

+}

+    local m="${2}"
+    machine_account_password_renewal_test_${m} "${server}"
+}
